verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents a paid check-deposit service: checks received in the mailbox are deposited on request and mailed out to the user's bank within 1 business day, so the paper never reaches the founder. Each deposit is a per-check request and the funds post through the mail, not a direct deposit. Missing for 10: endorsement handling, any reconciliation or deposit-confirmation records, automatic deposit without a manual request, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, checks that arrive in the mail get deposited to my bank account by the provider — endorsed, deposited, and reconciled without the paper touching my hands

citations.quote: Deposit any checks received in your mailbox without going to the bank. Pay per deposit with no setup or monthly fees.
Check deposit requests are processed and mailed out within 1 business day. Funds are usually processed by your bank within a week.
Get a VirtualPostMail (VPM) mailbox address to manage your mail, deposit checks, and handle shipments and returns.
